blocks.p: Score: the share of the 3,288 Logic and Math questions together (setups that finished both) answered right, the whisker its 95% interval. # is the tier: rows in one tier are not told apart by the paired test (a line separates tiers); – : with web or sample, not tiered.

blocks.h: Class: by the maker's total parameters, or by list price when the size is undisclosed *

blocks.p: Size by total parameters, as disclosed by the maker (for MoE models the label also shows active parameters): Tiny under 6B · Small 6B–15B · Medium over 15B up to 40B · Large over 40B. Models of undisclosed size, by standard list price per 1M input tokens: Efficient up to $0.50 · Workhorse up to $3 · Flagship over $3. Undisclosed: neither a disclosed size nor a list price.

One row per model: its highest reasoning setting (off < low < medium < high), a model with one setup that setup; a tie by the earliest run, then the name. Perplexity Decider 27B v1.2: its API setup on every part (its other setup is under other settings). The model's other settings are under its row; All setups lists every setup.

# is the tier: rows in accuracy order, the top row starts Tier 1, a row joins the tier unless the paired test behind the tie letters (exact McNemar, Holm-corrected over all pairs of tiered rows in view, p < 0.05) separates it from the tier's top row; otherwise it starts the next tier. – : with web or sample, not tiered.

Each question's score is the mean over a setup's runs (one run: 0 or 1; three seeds: 0, ⅓, ⅔ or 1); only questions every run of both setups answered count. The difference is the first setup's mean score minus the second's, in points. p: two-sided sign-flip (paired permutation) test on the sum of the per-question differences themselves (each flip keeps its size, e.g. ⅓ or 1), 200,000 random flips with a fixed seed. Holm: corrected over all 15 planned tests in this table, a pending one counted as p = 1 until its runs are in. 'Ahead' when the Holm-corrected p is below 0.05. LFM3-1.7B against the large models is its thinking-on 3-seed setup. English reading: Reading's 547 English questions (its per-question results, turkce #10695). A 3-seed row's questions per minute, cost and GPU time elsewhere on the page are the mean of its three runs' own values (each run's questions over its own wall time), not pooled.
